title: HTTP/3 RFC 9114 Positive Floor Work Item
summary: Promote the existing HTTP/3 positive floor into canonical RFC 9114 specification, architecture, verification, and requirement-home trace artifacts without changing runtime behavior.
planned_changes:
- Add a canonical RFC 9114 positive-floor slice to the HTTP/3 specification.
- Add architecture, work-item, verification, and requirement-home artifacts for the HTTP/3 frame, stream, SETTINGS, header-validation, and minimal client/server surfaces.
- Keep the runtime implementation unchanged while proving the already-implemented positive floor is trace-owned and auditable.
- Preserve the existing malformed-sequence requirement as a separate negative-protocol slice.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 frame, stream dispatcher, SETTINGS, header-validation, minimal client, minimal server, and requirement-home tests; validate the SpecTrace JSON artifacts; and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: External peer-matrix promotion or interop-runner harness work.
Standalone QPACK codec behavior already owned by SPEC-QUIC-RFC9204.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 positive floor is already implemented; this work item closes the canonical SpecTrace ownership so the RFC 9114 floor can be audited and extended from a stable trace baseline.
